aiOverview.content: As of April 2026, the 2025-26 NBA MVP race is a tight, top-tier battle between Victor Wembanyama (San Antonio Spurs), Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (Oklahoma City Thunder), and Nikola Jokić (Denver Nuggets). Wembanyama surged to the top of NBA.com's ladder in late March 2026 due to dominant two-way play, though Gilgeous-Alexander finished as the top contender for some experts.Top 2025-26 MVP Candidates (Late Season):Victor Wembanyama (Spurs): Widely considered the frontrunner in final projections due to elite, historic defensive impact (averaging over 3 blocks/game) and leading a revamped Spurs team to the top of the West.Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (Thunder): Continued his incredible consistency, leading the Oklahoma City Thunder to a top record while making clutch shots.Nikola Jokić (Nuggets): Remained a perennial candidate with massive efficiency, holding the Nuggets among the league's elite.Finalists & Voting:Finalists announced on April 19, 2026, include Wembanyama, Gilgeous-Alexander, and Jokić.While some analysts, like Yahoo Sports, favor Wembanyama, others lean towards SGA.Luka Dončić (Lakers) and Cade Cunningham (Pistons) received strong consideration, though they likely finished outside the top three.The winner will be officially revealed on NBA.com later in the 2026 playoffs.Kia MVP Ladder: Victor Wembanyama surges past Shai Gilgeous-Alexander for No. 1Mar 27, 2026 — San Antonio's superstar big man is heating up as the season winds down and leads the Kia MVP chase ... for now.
